name: suede-newsroom
description: Suede-owned editorial pipeline for agent-run content: six roles with written contracts, one inspectable record that travels between them, and a distribution stage that gives every asset its own argument instead of a shorter draft. Use when content agents return generic, duplicated, or unsourced work, when one flagship piece has to carry a week of distribution, when someone asks to build an AI content team or one-person media company, or when a founder wants a weekly interview-led content system
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一套由六类智能体协作的内容生产与分发流程，适合减少重复、空泛或无来源的产出，并将核心内容扩展为一周的多渠道素材。
